newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Dec 19.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Dec 19.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

-------- COMMENTS - Singapore bunkers rose on higher cargo prices and tight supplies, traders said on Thursday. A major said he sold 3,000 tonnes of 380-cst at $126 per tonne. Traders expected the market to be supported for most of next week, ahead of Christmas. Some sellers, anticipating higher cargo levels, decided to hold off supplies until later, limiting prompt supplies.
